rows.contract: Same first 15 frozen N=120 standard-unlabeled Oolong rows as SLM/direct/RLM subset.

decision.reason: The available stronger-family rows are adapter-bound. The standard-unlabeled N=15 smoke does not show an immediate reversal, and scaling a non-official adapter would not close the official-reproduction criticism.
decision.paper_action: Keep stronger-family rows in the supplement as bounded pressure checks; make the main claim explicitly about standard rlms v0.1.3 and operation-matched alternatives.
